source.title: L82: Recover exhausted repairs through diagnosis and renewable budgets
source.body:
Replace permanent two-attempt abandonment with bounded diagnostic recovery.

Scenarios: L82, L88
Specification: scenarios/loop-rules.md
Key: diagnostic-recovery
Priority: 0
Mode: implement
Provider: codex

Evidence from PRs #330, #349, #393, #405 and #425: all ten charged repairs invoked the model. Four attempts dealt with cancelled CI rather than failed tests. #393 advanced its implementation and resolved a conflict, then exhausted the same lifetime budget. #330 made no observed progress and its older final explanations were not retained.

Deliver controller-only cancellation reruns; diagnostic repair after two ordinary attempts; rolling limits and backoff that become eligible automatically; preserved atomic ownership and independent gates. Older PRs must use current runner setup. No manual counter reset and no user decision for engineering failures.

Observer: regression tests for classification, second CI rerun, ownership, rolling expiry, diagnostic evidence instructions; independently reviewed PR; a real formerly exhausted PR picked up and a cancelled-CI rerun without a model. Retain the run links and remaining failures. Root Codex owns branch codex/adaptive-repair.

goals.statement: Cancelled required Rust/web CI with no failed test lane gets a rerun from the trusted controller, at most twice per head, with no model invoked and no repair budget charged. A failed lane still routes to repair.
goals.observer: loop/dispatch.test.py L82 cancellation and second-rerun tests on main, plus a real hosted reconcile run that logs '#<pr>: reran cancelled CI <run>; no model invoked' and has no matching Builder/fix job or Ledger charge

goals.statement: After two ordinary repairs, a PR gets diagnostic repair instead of permanent abandonment. The diagnostic prompt has the agent read prior run logs and retained outcome.json/Ledger evidence, classify the failure (code, cancelled CI, setup/auth, publication), and record the cause and changed approach before editing.
goals.observer: test_l82_diagnostic_prompt_includes_prior_evidence_and_changed_approach and test_l82_two_repairs_escalate_without_abandoning_changed_or_unchanged_heads on main, plus a retained hosted diagnostic repair run on a formerly exhausted PR

goals.statement: Repair limits roll: at most six model repairs per rolling 24h. Backoff applies to an unchanged head and cause, from 15 minutes up to 2 hours. Expired budget becomes eligible again on reconciliation, with no manual counter reset and no user decision.
goals.observer: test_l82_rolling_budget_survives_new_heads_and_expires_without_user_reset and the setup-failure wait test on main; Status Running/queued row naming diagnostic eligibility or the next retry time with the last run link

goals.statement: Atomic per-PR Claim ownership and independent gates are preserved. Reruns are reserved before mutation. Review and repair share one Claim. No retry bypasses required checks or independent approval. Older PRs use main's runner setup.
goals.observer: L88 ownership tests in loop/dispatch.test.py on main; the change was independently reviewed at its exact head

goals.statement: Live: a real formerly exhausted PR (e.g. #330) is picked up again by reconciliation and its result is retained. A real cancelled-CI rerun happens without a model. Run links and remaining failures are recorded.
goals.observer: Hosted reconcile/fix run links and the retained outcome.json artifact for the formerly exhausted PR, plus a reconcile run log for the model-free rerun

evidence.remaining: No hosted observation yet of a model-free cancelled-CI rerun (a reconcile log line 'reran cancelled CI ... no model invoked').
No retained hosted diagnostic repair run yet. #330 is still open and holds loop-pr/330 (33a4b98); its diagnostic run and outcome.json need to be observed.
Status page rendering of eligibility/retry time with the last run link has not been observed on the live Status issue.
